product_metadata.title: Clamshell Food Containers 50pcs Clear-Hinged Plastic Containers, Durable Dessert Containers for Cakes, Sandwiches, Salad and Fruits, Stackable Clear To Go Plastic Containers Keep Your Food Fresh
features: 【High Quality Clamshell Takeout Boxes】Made of durable and eco-friendly OPS plastic, our clamshell containers are durable, sturdy, stackable and freezer safe. The reliable barlock closure press together very easily, solid seal maintains food freshness while makes transportation a breeze.

【Crystal Clear Hinged Plastic Container】Clear container for food makes contents are visible, people can see the appealling food through the clear box. Disposable food container with hinged lock tabs seal food securely, lock in freshness, keep food delectable and undamaged. Plus, the tight seal makes our containers odor resistant, preventing any unsavory smells from affecting the taste of your food.

【Perfect SIZE & Multi-Purpose】With the inner size of 3.9"L x 3.7"W x 2.8"H 🍰Perfect for cakes or cookies like cupcakes, coffee cake, bundt cake, carrot cake, muffins, pies, brownies, donut, scones; 🍔Suitable for lunch like salads, sandwiches, microgreens, rolls, bread, small snacks, candies; 🍓Greatly for fruit storage like strawberries, pineapples, etc. Meets all of your basic needs.

【Practical & Safe for Multi-Occasions】Smart hinged lock, tight seal and crystal clear look features ensure the to go container suitable for indoor/outdoor birthday party, wedding party, graduation party, family potlucks, holiday treats, baking business, baby shower, bridal shower, and retirement celebration etc. 🍰Foods are packed individually by plastic food containers with lids, this way is a great clean and safe to ensure guests will not get the food that someone else has touched.

【Value Pack & Customer Satisfaction Guarantee】Our value pack comes with 25/50 crystal clear plastic containers for food and desserts.You can choose the one that suits you well. If there are any problems, please feel free to contact us, you will get a 24-hour reply.
